status.description: Status is the current status of the ClusterConfig.

ClusterConfig.title: Cluster Config
ClusterConfig.description: ClusterConfig represents the Cluster-scoped configuration of the enterprise-only features (e.g. the OpenTelemetry Collector, the scaling of the Cluster components, the Certificate management defaults, etc...). It is a singleton resource that is automatically created upon the Cluster's installation. It is separate from, and complements, the core ClusterConfig.

collector.description: Collector sets the OpenTelemetry collector specific-options.

scaler.description: Scaler sets the scaling-related configuration of the Cluster components.

certificate.description: Certificate sets the Certificate management-related configuration.

defaultMode.title: Mode
defaultMode.description: Mode is how the certificate is obtained.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Certificate
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: Certificate sets the Cluster-wide Certificate management options

pipelines.description: Pipelines is the list of the Collector pipelines.

additionalInlineConfig.description: AdditionalInlineConfig is an additional raw YAML OpenTelemetry Collector configuration that is merged into the configuration generated by the Cluster. It is meant as an escape hatch for the options that are not exposed by the API.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Collector
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: Collector sets the OpenTelemetry Collector specific options

name.description: Name is the name of the Pipeline. It must be unique among the Pipelines.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type is the telemetry signal that is routed by the Pipeline.

exporters.description: Exporters is the list of the names of the CollectorExporters that the signal is exported to. Every name must correspond to an existing CollectorExporter. A CollectorExporter that does not support the Pipeline's Type is silently skipped.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Pipeline
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: Pipeline is a Collector pipeline that routes a single telemetry signal to a set of CollectorExporters

octovigil.description: Octovigil sets the Octovigil scaling-related configuration.

ingress.description: Ingress sets the Ingress scaling-related configuration.

collector.description: Collector sets the Collector scaling-related configuration.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Scaler
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: Scaler sets the number of replicas of the horizontally scalable Cluster components

replicas.description: Replicas is the number of Collector replicas.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Collector
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: Collector sets the scaling options of the OpenTelemetry Collector

replicas.description: Replicas is the number of Ingress replicas.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Ingress
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: Ingress sets the scaling options of Ingress

replicas.description: Replicas is the number of Octovigil replicas.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Octovigil
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: Octovigil sets the scaling options of Octovigil

upgradeRequest.description: UpgradeRequest is the currently ongoing or last requested Cluster upgrade.

lastUpgradeRequests.description: LastUpgradeRequests is the list of the most recent Cluster upgrades.

totalSuccessfulUpgrades.description: TotalSuccessfulUpgrades is the total number of the Cluster upgrades that have successfully completed.

totalFailedUpgrades.description: TotalFailedUpgrades is the total number of the Cluster upgrades that have failed.

licenseInfo.description: LicenseInfo is the information about the Cluster's currently set License.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Status
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: Status is the current status of the ClusterConfig

licenseSecretRef.description: LicenseSecretRef is a reference to the Cluster-managed Secret that contains the License itself.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the Cluster's License.

setAt.description: SetAt is the date at which the License was set.

stateCheckedAt.description: StateCheckedAt is the date at which the State was last checked.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: License Info
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: LicenseInfo is the information about the Cluster's currently set License

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the date at which the upgrade was requested.

state.title: State
state.description: State is the current state of the upgrade.

doneAt.description: DoneAt is the date at which the upgrade completed or failed.

request.description: Request is the upgrade request that was originally supplied to the UpgradeCluster method.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.title: Upgrade Request
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.ClusterC.description: UpgradeRequest is the state of a Cluster upgrade that was requested via the UpgradeCluster method

core.description: Core sets the version of the core Octelium package.

packageEnterprise.description: PackageEnterprise sets the version of the enterprise package.

packageCordium.description: PackageCordium sets the version of the Cordium package.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.UpgradeC.title: Request
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.UpgradeC.description: Request is the set of the Cluster packages that are upgraded

version.description: Version is the version that the package is upgraded to.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.UpgradeC.title: Core
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.UpgradeC.description: Core sets the version of the core Octelium package

version.description: Version is the version that the package is upgraded to.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.UpgradeC.title: Package Cordium
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.UpgradeC.description: PackageCordium sets the version of the Cordium package

version.description: Version is the version that the package is upgraded to.

octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.UpgradeC.title: Package Enterprise
octelium.api.main.enterprise.v1.UpgradeC.description: PackageEnterprise sets the version of the enterprise package

uid.description: UID is the unique UUID value for the object assigned by the Cluster. Read-only.

name.description: Name is the name of the object. It must be unique within a certain API/Version/Kind tuple.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the timestamp of creation of the object. Read-only.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the timestamp of when the object was last updated. Read-only.

displayName.description: DisplayName is the name that can be shown publicly for the object. Doesn't need to be unique.

description.description: Description is used to describe the object in a short sentence. Maximum characters are 1000.

labels.description: Labels is a map of string keys and values to organize objects.

tags.description: Tags is an optional array of tags that classify the Resource.

annotations.description: Annotations is a map of string keys and values that can be used to store arbitrary metadata about the object.

picURL.description: PicURL is the Picture URL of the resource.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is a unique ID that represent the current version of the resource object. Used by the Cluster to detect updates.

lastResourceVersion.description: LastResourceVersion is the ResourceVersion of the last update of the Resource.

actorRef.description: ActorRef is the object reference to the Actor resource, typically a Session, who is responsible for the current resource change. If ActorRef is not set, then the current change of the resource was done by the Cluster

actorOperation.description: ActorOperation is the gRPC full method triggered by the actorRef to modify the Resource

isSystem.description: IsSystem means that the resource is created by the Cluster and it cannot be managed by the administrators. Read-only.

specLabels.description: SpecLabels is map used internally by the Cluster for quick searches among lists of objects. Read-only.

isUserHidden.description: IsUserHidden means that the resource object is hidden from ordinary Users and should not be exposed via the User APIs.

isSystemHidden.description: IsSystemHidden means that the resource object is hidden by the Cluster and should not be exposed via the APIs.

systemLabels.description: SystemLabels is a similar map to specLabels. Used only by the Cluster.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.title: Metadata
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.Metadata.description: Metadata is the metadata that is common to every Cluster resource. It carries the resource's identity (i.e. its UID and name), its human-readable information as well as the Cluster-managed bookkeeping of the resource's versioning and provenance.

apiVersion.description: APIVersion is the API version of the reference resource

kind.description: Kind is the resource kind. A kind is unique per an APIVersion.

uid.description: UID is the resource object UID. A UID is unique across the entire Cluster.

name.description: Name is the resource object name. A name is unique per a certain kind.

resourceVersion.description: ResourceVersion is the resourceVersion of the resource.

octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.title: Object Reference
octelium.api.main.meta.v1.ObjectReferenc.description: ObjectReference is a reference to another Cluster resource. It identifies the referenced resource by its kind and either its UID or its name.
